purpose: Define the immutable pre-capital-action discipline plan required before any real Human Review Packet can be generated. The plan converts thesis, invalidation, stop, take-profit, add/reduce exposure and risk-budget intentions into explicit rule objects that can be checked later without silently rewriting history.

problem_elimination_pass.final_user_goal: Reduce emotion-driven investing errors by comparing a contemplated action with rules frozen before that action, without turning AI Core EVID into an autonomous trading system.
problem_elimination_pass.expensive_or_failure_prone_soft_assumpti: A discipline plan does not need a complex portfolio-management engine or free-form LLM reinterpretation on every review.
problem_elimination_pass.replacement: Freeze a compact typed rule snapshot once, preserve it by hash/version, evaluate it deterministically where possible, and surface unknowns or conflicts to the Human Decision Gate.

Delete: No automatic order mapping from a discipline trigger.
No mutable stop/take-profit values stored only as current state without historical versions.
No requirement for a new NLP interpretation of the original thesis on every review.
Avoid: Do not allow current P&L, hope for rebound, FOMO or desire to improve average cost to silently loosen frozen risk rules.
Do not treat missing data as PASS.
Do not overwrite prior rule versions after a new action is contemplated.
Absorb: Reuse Human Decision Gate for final capital-action authority.
Reuse Human Review Packet for rule-conformance presentation and behavioral-discipline flags.
actions.Substitute: Use versioned rule objects plus an explicit amendment ledger instead of mutable free-form trading instructions.
actions.Precompute_Reuse: Hash the full discipline plan and each rule family so future reviews can bind to exactly the plan that existed before the contemplated action.
actions.Optimize: Later usability improvements may simplify presentation, but cannot remove version history, unknown handling, human review or frozen-rule comparison.

plan_identity.discipline_plan_id: SHA256 canonical JSON of canonical_security_id + strategy_or_setup_spec_id + discipline_plan_version + frozen_at_utc before plan_sha256 is added.
plan_identity.plan_sha256: SHA256 canonical JSON of the complete plan before plan_sha256 is added.
plan_identity.version_rule: Version is append-only. A later version may supersede an earlier version but never edits or deletes it.

stop.allowed_switching: Only a switching/tightening rule explicitly frozen in this plan or a later version justified by new external evidence and preserving the old version.

take_profit.allowed_switching: A trailing or revised objective is permitted only if the switching condition was frozen before the contemplated change or is introduced as a new preserved plan version based on new external evidence.

unknown_data_policy.global_rule: A required rule input that is unavailable, stale, conflicted or not causally observable at review time cannot be coerced to PASS.

amendment_requires: whether amendment loosens or tightens risk
amendment_policy.risk_loosening_after_adverse_move: Blocked unless the new version is supported by a permitted basis independent of the desire to avoid or delay a loss; old version remains visible for comparison.
amendment_policy.user_override: The user may explicitly override a frozen rule at the Human Decision Gate, but the override is recorded as an override and does not become a rule amendment unless it separately satisfies this amendment policy.

packet_activation_gate.purpose: Authorize a real Human Review Packet only when a valid precommitted discipline plan and a separately valid research/strategy state both exist.
requires_all: Human Review Packet interface validation receipt status PASS
discipline plan validator status PASS for the exact plan hash
discipline plan frozen_at_utc precedes the contemplated capital-action review timestamp
strategy_or_setup_spec_id binds to the research/strategy authority used by the packet
all required rule families are complete
no required rule input is silently defaulted to PASS
human decision status is UNSET at packet creation

synthetic_validation_required: A complete plan with all rule families and frozen-before-action metadata passes.
Missing stop, take-profit, invalidation, add-position, risk-budget or exposure-limit rules fail.
A plan frozen after the contemplated action timestamp fails.
Unknown required evidence cannot resolve to PASS.
Averaging down solely because price fell cannot satisfy add-position eligibility.
A stop-loosening amendment based only on hope for rebound fails.
A precommitted stop-tightening switch may create a new valid plan version while preserving the prior version.
A user override can be recorded without mutating the plan.
No plan field authorizes order execution or brokerage routing.
No market price/return data are required for interface validation.
